title: Putting It All Together
coreMove: Compose the right move for the live situation while staying genuinely open to what may change.
sourcePressure: The chapter integrates the whole arc and warns that the framework is not a script; openness to being changed is the real skill, with real limits around non-engagement, power gaps, old issues, and written media.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Recapping a checklist or performing the framework mechanically.

sourceAnchors.name: the 2010 supplement
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says the 10th Anniversary Edition added answers to common reader questions about non-engagement, power gaps, illegitimate-feeling feelings, old issues, and written conversations.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The closing honesty checks matter because real conversations often arrive with silence, power, history, or a screen between people.

sourceAnchors.name: the framework is not a script
sourceAnchors.detail: The source warns that a mechanical performance of the moves sounds rehearsed and can feel manipulative.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The moves only help when they make you sound more like yourself, not like someone reciting a procedure.

sourceAnchorsNote: No chapter-specific real named anecdote, study, or researcher was available in the source sidecars for this chapter. Source anchors are traceable framework artifacts or edition/context facts only; do not invent named studies or reuse the source-banned Jack-Michael, Sydney, or author-family examples.

hook: Do not open ch12 with a generic dread-before-meeting frame
Do not begin with a definition of the chapter term
Do not use a negotiation-table abstraction as the first image
counterintuition: Avoid the shell 'you think X, but actually Y'
Avoid claiming the idea is simply counterintuitive
Avoid treating compassion as the surprising twist
tryThisNow: No 'pause and reflect on your communication style' action
examples: Avoid repeated coffee-table, classroom, narrow-kitchen, bus-depot, marker, mug, or radiator shells
Avoid six workplace meetings with changed names
Avoid making every case a manager feedback scene

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: use these six opening devices in order: question-as-hook; environmental detail before any human; dialogue first line; sensory detail first; retrospective first line; timestamp+name+action
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of timestamp plus named protagonist plus prop plus decision that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
